en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4838 - In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, a man said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan (as), "I told my wife, 'You are to me as the back of my mother if you leave the room,' and she left."
Imam (as) replied: "There is nothing upon you."
I said: "But I am capable of offering expiation."
Imam (as) replied: "There is nothing upon you."
I said: "I am capable of freeing one or even two slaves as expiation." Imam (as) said: "There is nothing upon you, whether you are capable or not."
